patterns.html_generation: HTML is generated as a String using format! macros and inline CSS
patterns.color_scheme: State colors defined in colors.rs using hex values for HTML and ANSI for terminal
patterns.testing: Unit tests at bottom of modules using #[cfg(test)] and #[test] attributes
patterns.data_structures: Bar struct contains id, glyph, state, stage, provider, timestamps, tokens, cost

existing_implementations.description: The gantt.rs file already implements HTML generation with tooltips, heatmap coloring, and summary statistics. Current implementation uses HTML title attribute for tooltips, percentile-based duration colors (green/amber/red), and a summary table with 6 metrics.
